name: WhatsApp Review
description: Read-first WhatsApp triage through WhatsApp Web with an approved-chat allowlist.

commands.name: /whatsapp
commands.description: Surface approved WhatsApp chats into Signal without starting a Codex turn.

requiredConfig.name: SABLE_WHATSAPP_APPROVED_CHATS_PATH
requiredConfig.description: Path to the approved WhatsApp chats JSON allowlist.

requiredConfig.name: SABLE_WHATSAPP_SESSION_PATH
requiredConfig.description: Path to the local WhatsApp Web session directory.

privateDataPolicy: Do not store WhatsApp session files, contact names, chat ids, message text, or approved-chat allowlists in the plugin manifest.
